%c[ui_gray_1]Docter is a collimator sight developed by Docter Optics to improve the effectiveness of shooting at medium distances. The sight was created to provide fast targeting and simplify the aiming process. Among its features are compactness, lightness and high targeting accuracy.

%c[ui_gray_1]The Leupold Mark 4 riflescope is designed by Leupold Stevens, a company known for its high-quality optics. This scope is designed for precision shooting at long ranges and is popular among hunters and target shooters. Distinguishing features of the Mark 4 include high impact resistance, clear image quality, and the ability to adapt to various shooting conditions thanks to the adjustments of the reticle and illumination.

%c[ui_gray_1]PK-A is a Belarusian collimator sight for light small arms, developed by specialists of the Minsk enterprise "BelOMO". Compared to standard sighting devices, it allows to reduce the time for aiming by more than three times while increasing the accuracy of aiming by more than two times. The design of the optical system of the sight allows its use in low light conditions and at night in combination with a night vision device.

%c[ui_gray_1]The PKS-07 optical sight was developed by specialists from the Leningrad Optical and Mechanical Association (LOMO). It was manufactured in 1997-1998 by NPO Pusk (Saint Petersburg) by order of the FSB of the Russian Federation. The PKS-07 features include high magnification and robust construction, which makes it a reliable tool for military purposes compared to its analogues.

%c[ui_gray_1]TS-12X scope was developed by the American company US Optics, which specializes in creating high-quality optical devices for shooters and hunters. This sight offers variable magnification from 3 to 12x, making it a versatile choice for close and medium ranges. The TS-12X features a robust design, anodized coating, and a high-precision ballistic reticle, providing clear aiming and maximum shooting accuracy in a variety of conditions.
